column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 / Prague

column2: You're awake, but don't you dare move yet!
Understand? You're my $$奴隷$$, and what I say is absolute!
Fine. I'll tell you about what happened that day.
The day of that great $$落雷$$... though of course you don't remember it. Honestly...
You did as I told you: you went up into the mountains to pick $$薬草$$.
Why didn't we go to a $$医者$$?
Hmph! A $$奴隷$$ like you questions me?
(N-No one but me gets to 　touch your body...)
Anyway, you went deep into the mountains and got caught up in some kind of $$事故$$, it seems!
I think it must have been a very serious $$事故$$...
(Because I saw it myself!)
(That day, after the rain stopped...)
(When I could finally move, 　I went into the mountains, and...)
(So many people's $$死体$$, lying all around you...!!)
(When I saw you, $$血だらけ$$, 　barely drawing breath,)
(I had no idea at all 　what had happened...)
(If you were gone from 　this $$世界$$... 　I...)
D-Don't get the wrong idea— I wasn't worried about you!!
*sniff*...
Hmph! I've said rather too much!
Make sure you get well soon.
As for you, I...
